lead.subhead: Clear and cold at dawn (about 36°), sunny to a high near 52. The Bulls trampled Minnesota 133-116. Jena Bishop upset Liz Carmouche in Chicago for the first PFL women's flyweight belt. OpenAI upgraded GPT-6 Pro with parallel agents, and UFC Edmonton goes tonight.

articles.deck: Box breathing, the 3-minute opener, then a Saturn Saturday for building the frame the next week runs on.
articles.body: Volume XLIV is live from Carpentersville on a clear, cold Saturday (about 36° at dawn, sunny, high near 52, no rain in the forecast). Sunday and Monday stay sunny and keep warming into the 60s. On the AI desk, OpenAI upgraded GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT with faster responses and parallel agents, and opened prompt-to-voice to every API customer. Anthropic posted a big third quarter ahead of its IPO, and Apple rolled out new App Store rules aimed at AI deepfake and nudify apps. In the NBA, the Bulls trampled the Timberwolves 133-116 at the United Center, led by as many as 21. Boston extended Payton Pritchard, and Golden State will open without Moses Moody and Jimmy Butler. Football: Caleb Williams is officially questionable despite a full week of practice, and Penix has no designation and will start when the Bears visit Atlanta Sunday at noon CT. Combat came home to Chicago: Jena Bishop beat Liz Carmouche 48-47 on all three cards for the first PFL women's flyweight title, avenging last year's loss. UFC Edmonton (Buckley vs Malott) is tonight. Saturday belongs to Saturn — structure, time, discipline. Solomon's line: prepare your work in the field first, then build your house. fall down 7 stand up 8.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Clear, cold Saturday, the day of Saturn. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Breathe like you're laying a foundation: square, even, every side the same length.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then build the frame the week will stand on.

mindset.body: Last year Liz Carmouche stopped Jena Bishop in the third round. Last night in Chicago, Bishop went five rounds with the same woman and took the belt 48-47 on every card, chasing a choke in the final minute when her legs were gone. That's Saturn's lesson: the loss is data, the structure is the comeback. Fix the frame, show up again, outlast. Win the first hour, set next week's three must-dos, and leave nothing to mood. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Saturday: run this right after Morning Charge, breath first and then the body. Cold start (mid-30s), so warm up indoors before the RipStick finisher. Saturn's day: strict form, full range, no shortcuts.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: GPT-6 Pro gets parallel agents; prompt-to-voice opens to all API customers
items.body: OpenAI upgraded GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT with faster responses, better plugin and tool use, and multiple agents that work on separate parts of a task in parallel (Pro users can watch each agent's progress). On the API side, developers can now create a custom voice from a text description and reuse it in GPT-Live sessions, plus nine new GPT-Live voices.

items.hed: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue jumps 45% ahead of its IPO
items.body: Anthropic said quarterly revenue rose about 45% to roughly $16.8 billion and that it was profitable on an adjusted basis with positive cash flow. The same week it gave METR researchers employee-like access with no veto over what they publish.

items.hed: Apple's new App Store rules target AI deepfake and nudify apps
items.body: Apple updated its App Store guidelines to go after apps that generate AI deepfakes or nudified images. Meanwhile xAI's Grok Voice 3.0 speech-to-speech model is now available through its API.
Chicago won every quarter, built a lead as big as 21, and won the paint 76-56 in front of 21,017 at the United Center. The Bulls are 3-2 in the preseason.

items.hed: Celtics sign Payton Pritchard to a two-year extension
items.body: Boston locked up the former Sixth Man of the Year through 2029-30, with a mutual option on the final year.

items.hed: Warriors will open without Moses Moody and Jimmy Butler
items.body: Golden State expects Moody back around December or January and Butler around January or February, leaving Stephen Curry with a thinner rotation to start the season.

items.hed: Caleb Williams officially questionable despite a full week of practice
items.body: Williams practiced fully all week after missing three games with a hamstring injury, but Ben Johnson is staying coy. The Bears went 2-1 without him using Case Keenum and Tyson Bagent.

items.hed: Penix has no injury designation and will start against Chicago
items.body: Michael Penix Jr. was a full participant Friday after the rib injury against Baltimore. Through three starts he's completed 67.5% for 719 yards, three touchdowns and one interception.

items.hed: Falcons rule out CB C.J. Henderson; Bears' T.J. Edwards also out
items.body: Atlanta loses Henderson (groin) and lists Za'Darius Smith questionable. Chicago is without T.J. Edwards, Keyshaun Elliott, Kyle Monangai and Dayo Odeyingbo, with Kyler Gordon and Tyrique Stevenson questionable. Kickoff Sunday noon CT on FOX.

items.hed: Jena Bishop beats Liz Carmouche for the first PFL women's flyweight title
items.body: Bishop avenged last year's TKO loss with a unanimous decision (48-47 on all three cards) at Wintrust Arena, nearly finishing a rear-naked choke in the fifth. Timur Khizriev edged Gabriel Braga by split decision in the co-main.

items.hed: Tonight: UFC Edmonton, Buckley vs Malott at Rogers Place
items.body: Joaquin Buckley meets Mike Malott in the welterweight main event; Erin Blanchfield vs Jasmine Jasudavicius is the co-main. Prelims 4 PM CT, main card 7 PM CT, entire card on Paramount+ in the U.S.

items.hed: Tonight: Fundora defends the WBC super welterweight title against Hadribeaj
items.body: Sebastian Fundora (24-1-1, 16 KOs) meets unbeaten mandatory challenger Ermal Hadribeaj Saturday at The Chelsea inside The Cosmopolitan. Fundora is riding a four-fight streak and eyeing an undisputed shot.

Saturday is the only English weekday still named for a Roman god: Saturn's day. In the old planetary order Saturn is the outermost, slowest planet, ruling time, limits, structure and the long game. The Solomonic grimoires give him the first hour after sunrise today, the hour magicians saved for binding, protection and work meant to last. Build something today that still holds next month.

In the Ophite diagram described by Origen in Against Celsus, the seven archons ruling the planetary spheres are listed in order, and the outermost, Saturn's, belongs to Ialdabaoth, the lion-faced chief of the archons who thinks he is the highest god. For the Gnostics, Saturn's sphere is the last gate before freedom. The practical reading: the walls that feel most permanent are often just the last checkpoint.

items.hed: What the soul gives up at the seventh gate
items.body: In the Poimandres, the first Hermetic treatise, the ascending soul hands back one vice at each planetary zone. At the seventh, Saturn's, it surrenders 'the falsehood that lies in ambush.' The mystics read it as the last thing to drop before clarity: the lie you tell yourself about why you can't start. Name yours today and leave it at the gate.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house' (Proverbs 24:27). Get the income, the groundwork and the plan in order before the visible project. On Saturn's day the counsel is plain: set the frame first, and the house goes up faster.

lesson.oneLiner: One tool per job, not one tool for everything.
beats: Lists like this sort AI tools by the job they do: answers, subtitles, logos, voice, documents.
Match each job to a real 7EightMade task: subtitles for story videos, document design for drop PDFs, logos for new offers.
Test one tool on one live task today and time it against how you do it now.
Keep it only if it's faster and the output is good enough to ship; archive the rest.
lesson.takeaway: Pick the one job you do most for 7EightMade, try the matching tool from the list today, and keep only what saves real time.
